solutions.title: Two-pointer binary addition
solutions.notes: Two indices + carry int — build result string
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Pointers at ends of `a`/`b`; sum bits + carry; prepend digit; finish leftover carry.

**Why preferred:** Minimal moving parts; easy to dry-run in an interview.

**Example walkthrough:** Add from the right with a carry: `1+1` → write `0` carry `1`, then `1+carry` → write `0` carry `1`, finally leftover carry → `"100"`.

solutions.title: Digit-wise sum with carry array
solutions.notes: Result digit array with unshift carry
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Align from the least significant digit into a result array; write `sum % 2` and `unshift(1)` on carry.

**vs recommended:** Same arithmetic idea. Prefer a carry integer and push digits then reverse (or build a string) to keep **O(n)**.

**Example walkthrough:** Same digit-wise sum into a result array, writing `sum % 2` and carrying with `unshift` when needed.
